lines.en: Crack crack, dry corpse walks
Skeleton shuffles
Corpse floats lightly
Shuffles in embers
Dry bones walk
Non-living walks
Moves slowly in driftstone
Dry corpse advances slowly
Bones wander in shadows
Dry corpse moves through rubble
Only when unobserved do I move my legs.

lines.zh: 我在漂移独石间挪了一步。
lines.en: I shift one step between drifting monoliths.
Skeleton stands still
Driftstone still
Corpse stands still
Dry corpse waits
Driftstone stands still
Silent in embers
Driftstone silent
Bones wait quietly
Dry corpse silent

lines.zh: 我立着，等你把视线移开。
lines.en: I stand and wait for your gaze to leave.
Eyeing you, dry corpse awakens
Gazing at you, dry corpse awakens
Sees you, dry corpse awakens
Looks at you, dry corpse comes alive
Dry corpse awakens in embers
Dry corpse revives, eyeing you
Dry corpse awakens in the embers
Dry corpse awakens, seeing you

lines.zh: 你一转头，我就成了柱子。
lines.en: You look away and I become a pillar.

lines.zh: 你的目光落下，我立刻石化。
lines.en: Your gaze lands and I turn to stone.

lines.zh: 我假装是石柱，别揭穿我。
lines.en: I pretend to be a pillar; don't expose me.
You stare, so I must hold still.
Gaze shifts and I live again.
Drift faded me...
The Overseer is broken...
Light consumes me...
My bones cannot withstand...
The light overcame me...
The light hurts me...
I was defeated by the light...
I cannot bear this light...
The light took my life...
The light erodes my existence...
Look at me, and you'll regret it.
Seek shelter in the driftstone.

lines.zh: 你手里的供品，引不来我的怜悯。
lines.en: The offering in your hand earns no mercy from me.

lines.zh: 我的石质身躯难以撼动。
lines.en: My stonelike form is hard to move.

lines.zh: 你无法说服我改变主意。
lines.en: You can't persuade me to change my mind.

lines.zh: 只有镐能触及我的本质。
lines.en: Only the pick can reach my core.

lines.zh: 注意我的存在，否则你将消失。
lines.en: Notice my presence, or you'll vanish.
My columns are everywhere.
Find me in the driftstone cluster.

lines.zh: 我的力量源自未被注视。
lines.en: My power comes from unwatched moments.
You collided with my will.

lines.zh: 我的石柱阻碍了你的路径。
lines.en: My stone columns block your path.
Your tools can't penetrate me.
You touched my defenses.
My body is unbreakable.
Collisions only increase the pain.
As a pillar, only a pick works.
You collided with my stillness.

lines.zh: 漂移独石中寻找我的身影。
lines.en: Find my form in the driftstone.

lines.zh: 我的存在是不可侵犯的。
lines.en: My presence is inviolable.
Find my mate to breed.

lines.zh: 漂移独石中寻找我的存在。
lines.en: Find my presence in the driftstone.
My columns await mating.
Breed with me for coexistence.

lines.zh: 漂移独石群中寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Find a mate in the driftstone cluster.
My columns need a mate.
Breed life with me.

lines.zh: 漂移独石中寻找我的生命。
lines.en: Find my life in the driftstone.

lines.zh: 教徒的骨头堆成了我，我也要延续。
lines.en: Built from cultist bones, I too must continue.

lines.zh: 在漂移独石中繁衍后代。
lines.en: Breed offspring in the driftstone.

lines.zh: 饥饿的骨骸在黑暗中注视着你。
lines.en: The skeletal form glares at you in the dark.

lines.zh: 被注视的漂移独石变得坚硬如石。
lines.en: The drift obsidian solidifies under your gaze.

lines.zh: 它只是个空壳，被注视时显现真身。
lines.en: It's just a hollow shell, manifesting under your gaze.

lines.zh: 你打破了它的宁静，它变得危险。
lines.en: You broke its peace, making it dangerous.

lines.zh: 它凝视着你，等待着你靠近。
lines.en: It stares at you, waiting for your approach.

lines.zh: 它由飞升者的遗骸构成，冰冷而无情。
lines.en: It is made from ascended disciples' remains, cold and ruthless.

lines.zh: 它的柱状形态无法被攻击。
lines.en: Its pillar form cannot be attacked.

lines.zh: 先知和朱砂，它的最终礼物。
lines.en: Prophecy and cinnabar, its final gift.

lines.zh: 你挖掘它，它的本质显现。
lines.en: You dig it, revealing its essence.

lines.zh: 在漂移独石群中，它静默而强大。
lines.en: In the drift obsidian cluster, it is silent and powerful.

lines.zh: 你进入它的视野，它注视着你。
lines.en: You enter its sight, it glares at you.

lines.zh: 它的凝视中充满了力量。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with power.

lines.zh: 你成为它的焦点，无法逃避。
lines.en: You become its focus, unable to escape.

lines.zh: 你被它的目光锁定，无法动弹。
lines.en: You are locked by its gaze, unable to move.

lines.zh: 你不看我，我就只是一具骨架。
lines.en: While you do not look, I am only a skeleton.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的注视，如同被冻结。
lines.en: You feel its gaze, freezing you in place.

lines.zh: 它选择你作为目标，准备攻击。
lines.en: It selects you as its target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的视线锁定了你的位置。
lines.en: Its sight locks onto your position.

lines.zh: 你被其凝视所震慑，无法移动。
lines.en: You are petrified by its gaze, unable to move.

lines.zh: 它的目光让你无法忽视。
lines.en: Its gaze cannot be ignored.
You turn your back and I approach.
I wait for the instant you blink.
You look elsewhere and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我的骨架在余光里长高。
lines.en: My frame grows taller in your side vision.

lines.zh: 你移开眼，我已站到你身旁。
lines.en: You glance away and I am beside you.
Its gaze shakes you.
You cannot escape its gaze.

lines.zh: 它在你心中留下了阴影。
lines.en: It casts a shadow in your heart.

lines.zh: 它的注视如同无形之手。
lines.en: Its gaze is an invisible hand.
You are controlled by its gaze.
Its gaze is like an abyss.
You are affected by its gaze.

lines.zh: 它的注视穿透你的灵魂。
lines.en: Its gaze penetrates your soul.
You are drawn to its gaze.

lines.zh: 它的注视如同死亡般冰冷。
lines.en: Its gaze is as cold as death.
Step, pause, wait for your attention to slip.

lines.zh: 柱子的影子挪了一点，是我。
lines.en: The pillar's shadow shifted; that was me.

lines.zh: 你回头太快，我僵在原地。
lines.en: You turned too fast, so I froze.
Don't watch me so long; it wearies me.
One lapse and I am against you.
I count where your eyes travel.
Only unwatched do I dare reach out.
My bone hand hovers at your shoulder.
Blink once more and I am there.
Stone does not move, but I do.

lines.zh: 你动一动，我就拆你一块骨头！
lines.en: Move and I'll break a bone!
Look at me, see who you are!
Do not touch me, I will wither!

lines.zh: 你的力量无法破我坚壳！
lines.en: Your strength cannot break my shell!

lines.zh: 我由死者之躯筑成，无法摧毁！
lines.en: I am made of dead flesh, cannot be destroyed!
You can only destroy me with a pickaxe!
Stare at me, but I won't retaliate!

lines.zh: 我是全视者的影子，沉默！
lines.en: I am the shadow of the Overseer, silent!

lines.zh: 你们这些活物，无法理解我！
lines.en: You living things cannot understand me!

lines.zh: 我的存在是为了守护漂移独石！
lines.en: My existence is to protect driftstone!
A bone hand closes on you from behind.
My blow lands while you look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 一击之后，我又装成柱子。
lines.en: After one hit I am a pillar again.

lines.zh: 飞升者的骨头砸在你背上。
lines.en: An ascetic's bones crash on your back.
You turn and see only a stone pillar.
That was for not watching me.
Spawns in driftstone biomes!
Corrupted ascended cultist bodies!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群系的守护者！
lines.en: Guardian of driftstone biomes!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群系的无言者！
lines.en: Silent entity of driftstone biomes!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群系的不死者！
lines.en: Undead of driftstone biomes!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群系中的守护！
lines.en: Guardianship of driftstone biomes!
Eternal of driftstone biomes!
Silent of driftstone biomes!
Gaze of driftstone biomes!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群系的守护者全视者！
lines.en: Overseer guardian of driftstone biomes!

lines.zh: 漂移独石群多了一根柱子。
lines.en: The monolith field gained one more pillar.
Cultist corpses piled into me.
I straightened among the monoliths.
From the shadow of the stones I emerge.

lines.zh: 又一具骨架立在荒原上。
lines.en: Another skeleton stands on the waste.
Unwatched, I wake.
The flames burn me...
The fall shattered me...
Water drowned me...

lines.zh: 爆炸震落我肩上的骨片。
lines.en: The blast shakes loose the bone plates on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 箭插进骨缝，我仍旧站着。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in my rib gap; I remain standing.
Magic destroyed me...
Starvation weakened me...

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的骨架白得刺眼。
lines.en: In the lightning, my skeleton glares white.
The void devoured me...
